facts.fact: 和好的性事前所未有地激烈——她手臂上留着被按在床上时压出的黄色指印。
facts.anchor: I notice small yellow circles dotted across my arm from where his hands pinned me to the bed, rendering me submissive.

facts.fact: 自从那顿午饭他像受不了她了——可当初他最爱她的「edge」。
facts.anchor: since we went for lunch with his mum, it’s almost like he can’t stand me.

facts.fact: 他有洁癖：碰她落在浴室地上的内裤都会起鸡皮疙瘩。
facts.anchor: It practically makes his skin crawl to pick up a pair of my knickers from the bathroom floor.

facts.fact: 她把咖啡洒在他新漆的窗台上，屏息等爆发——爆发没来，比爆发更吓人。
facts.anchor: I wait with bated breath for the childlike tantrum to erupt, but it doesn’t come

facts.fact: 半空的橡木衣柜与她无关：她只配住一米五长、发霉的储物柜——那是她在这个家的全部领域。
facts.anchor: Yet it seems that all those places are out of bounds. This is my domain in here, in this cupboard.

facts.fact: 他扔了她的低胸上衣，换成高领polo与长袖长裙——她反倒觉得自己「不识好歹」。
facts.anchor: I swear he threw out a bunch of my low-cut tops and replaced them with high-neck polos and long-sleeved dresses

facts.fact: 她说要去见「那个女人」，他坐直：你不是不信这些吗？
facts.anchor: ‘Competition? I thought you were joking. You said you don’t believe in any of that shit. You’ve not changed your mind, have you?’

facts.fact: 她去见通灵师的真实动机：修好他突然变掉的性情。
facts.anchor: the whole reason I’m going to see her in the first place is because of him and his sudden personality change.

facts.fact: 跑出家门时她想：这场奖也许中得自有原因。
facts.anchor: maybe I won that competition for a reason.
